# Office conversion fixtures

Synthetic documents generated by `generate.py`; no user data is included.
Word contains a table and an explicit page break (two pages). Excel has a
formatted table, formulas, and a one-page landscape print area. PowerPoint
contains two widescreen slides with text and shapes.

The modern files are created with python-docx, openpyxl and python-pptx. Their
legacy counterparts are saved by LibreOffice. Those Python libraries are
only regeneration dependencies. Tests use the checked-in files and skip
native Office conversion when LibreOffice is absent.

To regenerate, run `generate.py` in an environment containing those three
libraries. Set `PDFER_LIBREOFFICE` to a local soffice executable if needed.
